CFML Language Reference: Functions

REReplaceNoCase

Works like REReplace, but letters in the expression match both upper and lower case.

Category

String functions

Syntax

REReplaceNoCase(string, reg_expression, substring [, scope ])

Parameters

string
The string to work on.
reg_expression
The regular expression to search for. See REFind for the syntax.
substring
The replacement text; \1 to \9 insert subexpression matches.
scope
Optional. "ONE" (the default) or "ALL".

Returns

The string with the replacements made.

Usage

A back reference keeps the original capitalization of the matched text, which makes this the right tool for highlighting search words.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Text = "Netscape or netscape or NETSCAPE: all the same browser.">
<CFSET Word = "netscape">
<CFOUTPUT>
<P>#REReplaceNoCase(Text, "(" & Word & ")", "<B>\1</B>", "ALL")#</P>
<P>#REReplaceNoCase(Text, "NetScape", "Mosaic")#</P>
</CFOUTPUT>

See also

REReplace, REFindNoCase, ReplaceNoCase
